comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every number in High N' Dry: Clicker. Engine code contains no numeric literals except 0, 1 and array indices. Generator cost/rate ladder is Cookie Clicker's proven building curve renamed into the real business (brief: the loop is load-bearing, don't invent).

click.comment: clickPower = (baseCash * clickMult + perGeneratorBonus * generatorsOwned + cpsShare * cps) * globalMult, where cpsShare = baseCpsShare * (product of cpsShareMult upgrades). A tap is worth that share of one second's production. The base is deliberately tiny and non-zero so the 'convert production into click power' upgrades MULTIPLY an existing term instead of switching one on — switching it on from zero was a 294x cliff and broke the 25x step assertion (see PROGRESS.md M0).

generators.ladderComment: Cookie Clicker's building curve (cost ~x10, rate ~x8 per rung), renamed. A compressed x8/x5 ladder was trialled during M2 to make the top rungs reachable inside the 3h sim; it did that, but it also sent the tryhard profile exponential (1e36 in an hour) and made the prestige loop chaotic. Reverted. Reachability of the top rungs is a real open G4 item — see PROGRESS.md M2.

time.comment: Unit conversions, not balance values. Here so engine code holds no numeric literals.

sim.comment: Playbot profiles for the G3/G4 gates. dutyCycle = fraction of each minute spent tapping. goldenCatchRate = share of golden patties tapped.
sim.bootstrapComment: The idle profile taps ONLY until it owns its first generator, then never again. A literal zero-tap profile can never earn its first dollar (cash 0, cps 0) — that is true of Cookie Clicker too. 'Idle-only' here means 'idle after the opening', which is what the G3 softlock assertion is actually about. Flagged in PROGRESS.md.

prestigeHeuristic.comment: When the bot sells. Selling costs you every generator, so it is only worth it when the permanent multiplier jumps hard. Sell when the post-sale global multiplier would be at least this many times the current one. A gain-based rule instead made the bot reset constantly and never climb the ladder.
